rules.//: Deny everything by default; grant only the paths that need it.
rules.//days: The family logging app. Signed in with the shared account only.
rules.//public: Prices, caps and remaining availability. Anyone may read this; nobody may write it. The worker writes with a service account, which bypasses these rules.
rules.//reservations: Confirmed bookings, including customer phone numbers and vehicles. Readable by the signed-in family app so it can show the day's arrivals. Never writable from a browser - only the signature-verified webhook creates these.
rules.//pending: In-flight checkout holds. Nothing outside the worker has any business reading or writing these.
